item.description:
Words per minute, for everyone. If you never switched on Record dictations, the Statistics row showed a blank where your speaking rate should be. Dictations from before 0.18.0 kept their time but not their words, and those wordless minutes were pulling the rate towards nothing. They still count as time spent speaking, but the rate and the typing comparison now use only the dictations whose words are known. Your figure appears after about a minute of dictation on this version.

Missed a release? 0.18.0 put right a fortnight of real dictation (postcodes, spoken amounts, email addresses), kept your opening Yes or No in Draft and Prompt, and added the Statistics row. 0.17.12 gave Clean a second chance at pause-broken sentences, added a Permaculture dictionary, and turned update checks on by default. 0.17.11 taught the cleanup guard that "three" is the word you said when the transcriber wrote "3", and grew the Landlord and Business dictionaries. Every release, in order: github.com/romeo-golf-software/dictation-releases/releases.
